description: - For frame sizes 525, 570 and 600 use the 46mm rake fork - For frame sizes 495 and 555S use the 55mm rake fork Frame accepts 28.6mm clamp-on front derailleur, deep-drop 47/57mm Allen key fitting brakes, rear OLN is 132.5mm to accept either 130 or 135mm hubs. Frame will take 32c Schwalbe Supreme tyre with mudguards. Thorn 858 double butted seamless cro-mo tube, one set of bosses on rear triangle for racks or mudguards, down-tube bosses accept either stops or Shimano down-tube levers but not Campagnolo. Includes: - 1 1/8" (28.6mm) Orbit XL2 threadless headset - 27.2mm alloy micro adjust seatpost - Bottom bracket cable guide Frame weight is 2.3kg (average). Click on the XL image to see the size matrix, view at maximum magnification. NOTE: Does not include: fixing screws, down tube cable stops or bottom bracket. If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk. Please note that we no longer have an open showroom.
